settings.title: What is this for?
settings.content: This software upgrade is intended for users of the MyoLift MD Ultra device who wish to access advanced features available in the MD version. By upgrading, practitioners can offer more personalized treatments, addressing specific skin concerns with tailored protocols.

settings.title: What is included?
settings.content:
• USB Drive: Contains the MD software upgrade for your MyoLift Ultra device.
  • Upgrade Instructions: Detailed directions to assist you in the upgrade process.
  • Instructional Video: A comprehensive video tutorial to guide you through the software installation and utilization of new features.

settings.title: How To Use
settings.content:
1. Receive the USB Drive: Upon purchase, you will receive a USB drive containing the MD software upgrade.
  2. Follow the Upgrade Instructions: Detailed directions for the upgrade process are provided. Additionally, a comprehensive instructional video is available to guide you through each step.
  3. Implement Customized Protocols: After the upgrade, you can create up to 9 customized protocols by selecting specific waveforms, intensities, and durations to suit individual client needs.

settings.title: Benefits
settings.content:
• Personalized Treatments: Offer individualized care by customizing protocols to meet unique client needs.
  • Increased Client Satisfaction: By addressing specific concerns, clients are more likely to experience noticeable results, encouraging repeat visits.
  • Expanded Service Offerings: Enhance your practice by providing advanced treatment options previously unavailable with the standard MyoLift Ultra device.

settings.title: Product Features
settings.content:
• Customizable Protocols: Create up to 9 personalized treatment protocols by selecting waveform, intensity, and duration.
  • Enhanced Treatment Versatility: Tailor treatments to address specific client skin concerns effectively.
  • User-Friendly Upgrade Process: Comes with clear instructions and a tutorial video for seamless installation.
